description.value: Rosewood Inn is a VI Resorts timeshare vacation club property housed in a historically preserved building steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Each unit is unique in style and décor, and the location puts cyclists within easy reach of heritage home neighbourhoods, Beacon Hill Park, and the Galloping Goose Trail. The Royal BC Museum and Fisherman's Wharf are also nearby on foot.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a VI Resorts (Vacation Internationale/Westgate) timeshare club property called 'Rosewood Inn' at 595 Michigan St, Victoria, BC V8V 1S7 — address matches OSM. The OSM brand tags (brand=Rosewood, brand:wikidata=Q7368777) incorrectly associate it with the unrelated luxury Rosewood Hotels & Resorts chain; the OSM name 'Rosewood Victoria Inn' also differs from the website name 'Rosewood Inn'. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content; the only amenity-adjacent OSM tag is internet_access=wlan, which the website does not corroborate. The website does list multiple nearby restaurants explicitly.
concerns: OSM brand tags (brand=Rosewood, brand:wikidata=Q7368777) incorrectly reference Rosewood Hotels & Resorts (a luxury hotel chain); this property is actually operated by VI Resorts / Vacation Internationale, a timeshare company — the two brands are entirely unrelated.
OSM name 'Rosewood Victoria Inn' does not match the website name 'Rosewood Inn'; the 'Victoria' qualifier appears only in the OSM record.
Property appears to be a members-only timeshare club; the website provides no indication that non-members can book — public accessibility is unconfirmed.
No phone number present in OSM; the 800-444-6633 number on the website is the VI Resorts corporate owner-services line based in Bellevue, WA, not a local property contact.
